searchText: The fee recipient displayed on beaconchain.kintsugi.themerge.dev seems to be invalid? I want to get into blockchain development on ethereum. I am fully fluent in python and above average in java. Can someone suggest me a path from where I can begin the blockchain development? <#672059911034634243>
